title: UN Commission finding on forcible transfer in Gaza
affected_population: Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip
summary: The Commission assessed evacuation orders and mass displacement in Gaza through 31 December 2023.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli evacuation orders were at times insufficient, unclear and conflicting, and that the forced displacement of civilians in the circumstances amounted to forcible transfer.
legal_characterization: Factual and war-crime finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission methodology in paragraphs 3-7, including its reasonable-grounds standard. This is attributed to the Commission and is not a court judgment or an individual conviction. Classification judgment: this record uses displacement for a finding the report legally characterizes as forcible transfer; manual review is requested.
